furniture.reason: The owner: design the washrooms with approximately four stalls and three sinks. Every washroom gets stalls along the longest opaque wall without a door, each 0.9 by 1.5 m with its toilet against the wall, and a counter with three sinks along another wall, opposite the stalls where it can be. Fewer stalls where the wall is shorter. Second pass (owner): stalls along the wall farthest from the door, aligned to the corner farthest from it; room 31's sinks on the small partition facing the stalls; room 14 like 31; room 16's stalls in the corner; rooms 66 and 67 single washrooms; room 38 laid by hand in its U-shaped pocket (O41 to O45). Third pass (owner): a sink counter never stands over a stall (it moves along its wall or to another wall); the single washrooms 66 and 67 get a smaller toilet space; and since the plan view hides what stands against a south wall, the sinks avoid the south wall when another wall will do, so the owner can see them.
furniture.room_note: owner: stalls against the back wall (the east wall, farthest from the west door) like room 31; sinks on the partition facing them
